mapping.summary: Change control with approvals and audit trail on records
claims: Excludes blank, zero-value and empty date fields from the change log until initial values are committed
Suppresses logging until a meaningful event occurs
Snapshot logging captures immutable time-stamped states of critical fields
Automatically restricts changed records and starts approval workflows
Blocks printing or emailing of reports for restricted documents
FactBox shows changes and pending approvals
Different log retention periods per table
Conditional field monitoring can fire an event, show a message or block the change
Workflow wizard builds approval workflows for virtually any table without a developer
Segregation of duties prevents approvers approving their own changes
Runs on the native change log with no external connectivity
Free complimentary plan for 1 to 4 users
Tiered plans by user count up to 50 users
